title: Investor onboarding portal for a private equity fund
brief_text:
Project: investor onboarding portal for a private equity fund.
- Limited partners complete subscription documents online and sign them electronically.
- Each subscription goes through draft, submitted, under review, approved and countersigned states.
- The compliance team reviews KYC/AML checks before a subscription can be approved.
- Verify investor identity through our KYC provider's API.
- Fund admins see every investor; investors see only their own documents.
- Keep a full audit trail of who changed any investor's commitment amount.
- Capital call notices are emailed to all investors with their pro-rata amounts.
- A dashboard shows total commitments, called capital and outstanding amounts per fund.
- Import the existing investor list from the spreadsheet our fund administrator keeps (about 600 investors).
- We might also want a side-letter tracker later, depending on how the first close goes.
- Export the investor register to Excel for the auditors.
- Not decided yet whether investors need two-factor login.
- Possibly an AI assistant that pre-fills subscription forms from uploaded passports, if the budget allows.
expected_confirmed_quotes: draft, submitted, under review, approved and countersigned
